propositions: LLM gate operations emit no progress to stdout/stderr between invocation and final verdict, routinely exceeding 600s silence budgets while healthy runs complete
Supervisor watchdog processes cannot distinguish a healthy multi-minute gate call from a hung process and kill correct runs mid-completion, stranding work in intermediate states
The gate operations' silence is deliberate per ADR 0089 for inbound liveness but lacks recorded justification for local compute phases (27s prologue, 40s overlap retrieval) that are not model calls
Existing test suite pins no-total-runtime-timer and silence-tolerance as correct behaviour, constraining any progress-emission remedy to be purely additive without truncating healthy runs
Closing work via gates is the last step of long autonomous runs where failure risk is highest and investment greatest, making gate silence hostile to the documented agent automation patterns
